scope: Read-only audit of retained Stage B raw and unit-direction FP32 naive-versus-tiled comparisons; no GPU execution or new numerical measurements.

unit_direction_definition.raw: After constructing naive and tiled OLMo models on CUDA and converting weights, draw tokens with torch.randint(2,vocab,(B,T),device=cuda), then v=torch.randn(B,T,V,device=cuda).bfloat16().float().
unit_direction_definition.normalized: Replace v by v / v.norm(), with the norm and division performed in FP32. The normalized cotangent is FP32 and need not remain BF16-representable.
unit_direction_definition.backward: logits.backward(v.to(logits.dtype)); no CE objective or answer mask in these fixtures.
unit_direction_definition.precision: FP32 comparison modes disable autocast and run before separate BF16 modes. BF16-roundtripped cotangent values do not imply BF16 computation.
unit_direction_definition.norm_note: Raw D32 records did not retain cotangent L2 norms. D256/T16 retains90.52316284179688. Unit norms are retained; three are1.0, D256/T128 is0.9999999403953552.

legacy_metric_definitions.elementwise: abs(reference-actual) <= 2e-6 + 2e-5*abs(reference), for every coordinate; actual values must also be finite.
legacy_metric_definitions.reference_rms_recording: reference_rms is floored at1e-12 in the original metric function; this floor is inactive in the audited records.

rng_initialization_order: CUDA randn cotangent draw, round through BF16 to FP32
reproducibility.common_configuration: 12layers, four full-MHA heads, MLP4D/GELU, pre-norm ALiBi(max8), affine Q/K and block/final norms(eps1e-5), no biases/dropout/RoPE/embedding norm, untied head, recurrent_layers[3],rho1,Mitchell initialization,tiled chunks4. See exact model_config per record.
reproducibility.backend_differences: Naive reference_eager=True; tiled reference_eager=False. Original report stores the naive config, while current config() explicitly constructs the tiled variant.
reproducibility.execution: Single H10080GB; Python3.12.3, PyTorch2.13.0a0+8145d630e8.nv26.06, CUDA13.3, cuDNN92300; deterministic algorithms and TF32-off recorded; current harness requests highest FP32 matmul precision and one CPU thread.
reproducibility.compiler: Recompile limit64, accumulated limit256, fail_on_recompile_limit_hit=True. Retained graph_break dictionaries are empty and compiled graphs were observed. Old common validator checks unsupported counters; new harness should also explicitly reject graph breaks/no-graph fallback.
reproducibility.cublas: Current harness uses os.environ.setdefault(CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG, :4096:8); the original reports do not record the effective environment value.
reproducibility.available: Arguments, full model config, fixture hashes, software/hardware/source hashes, aggregate comparison metrics and compiler counters. Current script matches D256/T16 raw and all unit records. All compared current source hashes match the retained sources. D32 raw/unit token hashes match for each corresponding length.
reproducibility.missing: No initialized checkpoint/model-state hash, saved gradient tensors, raw cotangent tensor, failing coordinates/counts, or per-coordinate reference values. Historical D32 harness hashes differ from current; their byte-identical source was not established in this audit.
reproducibility.pilot_difference: Raw fixtures initialize recurrent models on GPU. Stage B paired training initializes SEQ on CPU then converts to R3; these are not the pilot initial/trained checkpoints. Old input hook is at the embedding output, not recurrent block3 input.

interpretation_limits: Legacy raw failures remain failures; passing normalized directions does not retroactively waive them.
All raw tensor relative-L2 errors are<=1.05e-6, but that fact alone neither proves backward correctness nor identifies cancellation as the cause.
The original summaries cannot identify near-zero offending coordinates. Maximum absolute error and maximum legacy-tolerance violation can occur at different coordinates.
No actual masked-CE naive-versus-tiled comparison, independent cotangent-scaling check or paired optimizer-update comparison is present in these records.
BF16 failures and optional gradient-accumulation failures are separate from the FP32/no-accumulation path and are not used to invalidate it.

Unit-direction fixtures cover initialization only, with no claim over arbitrary trained weights. The D256/T128 unit fixture uses vocabulary1024 and has no matching raw fixture among these eight records.

new_harness_criteria_not_applied_as_lega.decision_owner: Root selected fixed independent checks for the new investigation; no new numerical experiments are performed in this audit.
new_harness_criteria_not_applied_as_lega.justification: Reuse the original FP32 relative-error coefficient as an explicitly declared per-tensor engineering budget, combined with independent scaling, actual task loss, persistent-write gradients and optimizer-update evidence; it is not a formal floating-point theorem.
new_harness_criteria_not_applied_as_lega.scaling: At fixed forward state, compare G(alpha*v)/alpha with G(v) for alpha in{1/32,1,32} and a CE-sized direction. Preserve the legacy elementwise checks separately.
new_harness_criteria_not_applied_as_lega.denominator_floor_recommendation: For homogeneous scaling diagnostics, use an explicitly recorded floor proportional to ||v||2 (and divided bysqrt(n) for RMS), or report when a fixed floor is active. Do not silently conceal zero reference tensors.
new_harness_criteria_not_applied_as_lega.near_zero_recommendation: Record failed-coordinate reference and candidate values, reference RMS/norm, failure count, structural-zero status and the worst normalized violation. Classify coordinate-relative error as ill-conditioned only with that evidence.
